title: Outlook calendar
summary: Ava reads your Outlook (Microsoft 365) calendar and tells you what is on and when you are free. With changes on, she can propose a new event. Nothing is added without your OK, and nobody is invited.

tools.name: m365_calendar_events
tools.description: List the owner's Outlook events for a day or a few days (UTC times). Returns items you can cite (title, time, place, organiser).

days.description: How many days (the owner's setting caps the window)

tools.name: m365_calendar_free_busy
tools.description: When the owner is busy and free over a day or a few days (UTC). No titles or details.

tools.name: m365_calendar_create_event
tools.description: Propose a NEW event on the owner's own Outlook calendar. It always waits for the owner's approval, shows the exact event, and invites nobody. Never edits, moves or declines anything.

start.description: ISO start time with its offset, e.g. 2026-11-25T15:00:00+05:30

changes.description: Let Ava propose new events. Each one waits for your approval.
